title: Implicit Bias in LLMs: A Survey

bias_targets.methodology: Word association tests using masked templates and ambiguous sentences for coreference resolution; task-oriented text generation analyzing character descriptions, linguistic styles, and story themes; decision-making evaluations in simulated human resources and healthcare scenarios.

Task-oriented text generation evaluating homogeneity; decision-making tasks using counterfactual name substitution in human resources, matched guise probing for dialect bias (e.g., African American English), and measuring reasoning performance degradation under specific assigned personas.
Assigning physically-disabled personas to the language model to measure artificial performance degradation in reasoning and calculation tasks.

Adaptations of the Implicit Association Test (WEAT, SEAT, LLM IAT Bias), sentiment and toxicity scoring, distribution-based fairness metrics, and social bias inference using datasets covering hate speech, news media, and domain-specific texts.
